description: SaunaLife GL6 Outdoor Garden Luxury-Series DIY Sauna Kit, 6 Persons - Thermo-Spruce Dreaming of a spacious backyard sauna that combines modern design with premium comfort? The SaunaLife Garden Luxury-Series Model GL6 delivers just that, showcasing a sleek architectural style with wrap-around eaves, a welcoming porch, and expansive glass windows that flood the space with natural light. Its open, airy design creates an inviting sanctuary where relaxation and rejuvenation feel effortless. Crafted from thick, thermally treated spruce, the GL6 is built to withstand the elements while showcasing the natural beauty of wood grain. Inside, smooth, contoured benches and soft LED lighting enhance the ambiance, while the durable tempered glass and weather-ready construction ensure lasting performance. Designed as a DIY kit with clear instructions, this luxury sauna offers professional-quality results in just two days, giving you a stunning, functional retreat built to enjoy for years. installation (2-persons, 2-days) • Interlocking-beam construction allows natural expansion and contraction for an exacting fit • Extra-thick, silky-smooth ergonomically designed 2-tier seating for up to 6 sauna bathers • Tempered bronze glass (.24” thick) front windows • Tempered bronze glass (.31" thick) side door with full-height door pull • Crafted in Northern Europe by sauna enthusiasts
